about: The style sheet the build reads. Change a value here and every video built in this style follows it; nothing per clip.

broll.first_clip_of_a_page_means: no automatic click-through: a clip opens on its section
broll.lead_in_means: the click plays this long before its line, so the section is on screen as the line starts
broll.click_through: only on a marker that asks for it with | arrive: when the words point to where to find something ('in the docs', 'on the bulk upload page'). The cursor clicks the article's card on the page that lists it, the article opens on the section, lead_in_seconds before the line
broll.concepts: a line that explains an idea (dense vs sparse) gets an [**Animation:** ...] that draws it, not a page recording

camera.window_corner_means: the presenter's window goes to this corner first when it is free; it never covers the list, code or a figure

zoom.means: the cut is split into this many stretches, out / in / out: one small zoom-in held in the middle
